title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
description: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k`th largest element in the array.
input_format: First line contains `n` and `k`. Second line contains `n` integers.
hints: Use a min-heap of size k: maintain only the k largest elements seen.
Alternatively, sort descending and pick index k - 1.
Python's `heapq.nlargest(k, nums)[-1]` is concise and optimal.

starter_code.python:

reference_solution:
import sys, heapq
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[2:2+n]]
    print(heapq.nlargest(k, nums)[-1])
